svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: NoA = 4 · medium stiffness · HM-3 · camera + range fan + IMU · ROS 2 Jazzy + Gazebo Harmonic

g.text: speed model v = g(k, b, mode) from gait state
IMU ψ, r + gait speed → odom → base_link
keyframe every 5 cm or 10° · match by marker id
re-seen marker closes the loop → map → odom
obstacles (d, ḋ, TTC, histogram) · target (θ, d, looming TTC) · ψ, r
P: ψ_ref − ψ → r_ref · PI: r_ref − r → b
bias ramp · switch at phase zero
Decisions are checked top to bottom in priority order: teleop › collision › avoidance › target › mission goal. Only the heading cascade sets the bias b.
Dashed: perception data feeding every decision. Mode switches take effect at the next gait-phase zero crossing.
